summary: Navigator settings can come from the command line, environment variables or a settings file, searched in order: ANSIBLE_NAVIGATOR_CONFIG, ./ansible-navigator.<ext> in the project directory, then ~/.ansible-navigator.<ext> in your home. Files can be JSON (.json) or YAML (.yml/.yaml); more than one settings file in the same directory is an error.
questions: Where does ansible-navigator look for its settings file?
Why does ansible-navigator error about multiple settings files?
Can the ansible-navigator settings file be YAML?

answer_card.title: Where ansible-navigator finds its settings file
answer_card.answer_md:
Navigator uses the first match:

1. `ANSIBLE_NAVIGATOR_CONFIG` environment variable (file path)
2. `./ansible-navigator.<ext>` in the project directory (no leading dot)
3. `~/.ansible-navigator.<ext>` in your home directory (leading dot)

Format: JSON (`.json`) or YAML (`.yml`/`.yaml`). Only one settings file is allowed per directory; more than one is an error.
